transcript:
[Verse 1]
Dropped a glass, it hit the tile —
One loud crack, now you're on trial.
Takes one second to make a mess,
An hour later, still in distress.

Ironed in a wrinkle, set it deep,
Now the crease is mine to keep.
Spilled the paint, missed the tarp,
Oops! Now the couch looks avant-garde.

[Chorus]
It’s always harder to fix than it was to break,
One dumb move, now it’s ten hours late.
Snap your fingers — oops, you blew it!
Now you’re stuck with glue and ruin.
Measure once, screw it twice,
Welcome to the cost of bad advice.

[Verse 2]
Typed one line, crashed the site,
Debug hell through half the night.
Tore the tag off — oops, no return,
Now your wallet gets to burn.

Cut the wire you shouldn’t have cut,
Now the whole house smells like a rut.
You blinked once and nuked the vibe,
Now you owe beers to the whole tribe.

[Chorus]
It’s always harder to fix than it was to break,
A single slip, now your whole day aches.
Snap decisions, lifelong chores,
Hope you like patching metaphorical floors.
Measure once, wreck it fast —
Good luck cleaning up your past!

[Bridge – Spoken, like a PSA over punk strumming]
“Just a friendly reminder:
You can delete a file in one click.
Restoring it? That’s a three-hour rabbit hole.
Congratulations, you played yourself.”

[Final Chorus – double time]
It's always harder to fix than it was to break,
Entropy's the icing on your dumb mistake.
Build it slow, break it quick —
Welcome to the human trick!
Measure twice? Ha! That’s rich.
Cut it wrong and now it’s glitched.

[Outro]
One slip, ten steps back —
That’s the universal punk rock fact.
